Pipeline B turns **NAMRIA** administrative-boundary shapefiles into the curated **hierarchical
per-class GeoJSON** that is the dataset's recommended end product. Its intermediate stages —
`raw` and `enriched` — are documented under [Boundaries](../boundaries/index.qmd).

## Flow

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  shp[("namria/phl_admbnda_adm{0-4}_*.shp<br/>v2023-11-06")]
  conv["namria_converter.py<br/>shapefile → GeoJSON<br/>(Douglas-Peucker simplify, 0.005°)"]
  raw[("stage 1:<br/>raw_t0p005/")]
  cov["coverage.py<br/>PSGC pcode vs GeoJSON pcode"]
  huc["generate_huc_mapping.py<br/>huc_adm2_mapping.json<br/>(HUCs, MM districts, SGAs)"]
  enrich["enrich.py<br/>adds psgc_id / code / name / status / match_confidence"]
  enr[("stage 2:<br/>enriched_t0p005/")]
  cls["classifier.py<br/>assigns PSGC type/class"]
  split["splitter.py<br/>per-class files"]
  hier["hierarchical.py<br/>orchestrate classify → split → report"]
  cur[("curated:<br/>hierarchical_t0p005/<br/>&lt;class&gt;.geojson +<br/>classification_report.json +<br/>summary.md")]

  shp --> conv --> raw
  raw --> cov --> huc --> enrich --> enr
  enr --> cls --> split --> hier --> cur
```

## Stages

- **`namria_converter.py`** — shapefile → GeoJSON (Douglas-Peucker simplify, default `0.005°`).
  Output: [raw tier](../boundaries/raw.qmd).

- **`coverage.py`** — PSGC pcode vs GeoJSON pcode comparison per admin level.
- **`generate_huc_mapping.py`** — builds `huc_adm2_mapping.json` for HUCs, MM districts, and Special
  Geographic Areas. See [HUC mapping generation](huc-mapping.qmd) and the
  [HUC mapping reference](../references/huc-mapping.qmd).

- **`enrich.py`** — adds `psgc_id`, `psgc_code`, `psgc_name`, `psgc_status`, `match_confidence`.
  Output: [enriched tier](../boundaries/enriched.qmd).

- **`classifier.py`** — assigns the PSGC type/class (barangay, HUC, ICC, component city, …) per
  feature.

- **`splitter.py`** — splits enriched features into per-class files.
- **`hierarchical.py`** — orchestrates phases 3–5 (classify → split → report). Output: the curated
  [hierarchical tier](../boundaries/index.qmd) plus `classification_report.json` and `summary.md`.

## Running it

```bash
brgybnd build-hierarchical --date 2023-10-24
```

`build-hierarchical` runs convert → enrich → classify → split. Use `--skip-convert` /
`--skip-enrich` to reuse existing intermediate stages. See the [CLI reference](cli.qmd).
